race.description: Fernhill Tavern Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: SUPER VITALITY (8) went around at $1.60 last start over 1150m at the Beaumont track but didn't quicken as expected and finished a well-beaten third. Should be spot on at the third run of the prep. Just needs luck from a tricky gate to be right in the finish. LOTSA DIPITY (12) met with little support on debut last time out in the same race as SUPER VITALITY but caught the eye late, just denied third spot by today's rival. Expecting some natural improvement off that run and she poses a genuine threat. FRATIANNO (3) recorded his 12th minor placing from 23 career runs when a fast-finishing second over 900m at Coonabarabran recently. Ran a nice race here at this trip in a $50k maiden the run prior. Only for the bravest of punters. WOMENSWORLD (14) has been kept fresh since a distant second when fresh from a spell over 1000m here five weeks ago. Lightly raced filly with plenty of upside. CEDAR DREAMS (1) for wider exotics first-up from a six-month spell.
